title: 2026-09-11 Research Notes — Consciousness, Metastability, Hidden States and Enlightenment Operationalization
status: new project research extension; neuroscience methodology and model-design notes
novelty_scope: Novel within the project research record on 2026-09-11. Hidden Markov models, entropy rate and metastability are established scientific tools; their integration here is a new project research move.

research_findings.finding: The old Human Map tendency to assign one fixed fractal dimension, frequency or biochemical value to 'Enlightenment' should be replaced by a multivariate state/trait design. The scientifically tractable question is how measurable neural, behavioral and phenomenological variables change over time and across conditions.
research_findings.candidate_state_vector: q=(spectral_shape, PAC, complexity, metastability, integration, segregation, connectivity, report, behavior, physiology)
research_findings.boundary: No component or weighted sum is enlightenment itself.

equations: pi=pi P for a stationary distribution when it exists
research_findings.finding: A hidden Markov model supplies a disciplined way to describe recurring latent brain/network states and their transition probabilities instead of treating consciousness as one continuous scalar.

equations: For a discrete first-order HMM, P(T_i=k)=(P_ii)^(k-1)(1-P_ii)
research_findings.finding: The ordinary HMM supplies a geometric dwell-time baseline. Systematic deviations can motivate a hidden semi-Markov or other duration-aware model rather than being labeled mystical persistence.
research_findings.test_path: Compare observed dwell-time distributions with the fitted HMM expectation and alternative duration models.

research_findings.finding: State-transition entropy rate measures unpredictability of switching under the fitted Markov model. Low entropy can mean rigid persistence; high entropy can mean flexible or noisy switching. Neither is automatically 'better' without task and behavioral context.
research_findings.units: nats/transition when natural logarithms are used

research_findings.finding: Metastability should not be used as a synonym for complexity or spirituality. It should refer to transient coordination/state switching under an explicit dynamical or statistical definition.
candidate_measures: variance of a Kuramoto order parameter when phase data are justified
distance to or residence near metastable/ghost attractor structures in an explicit model

research_findings.finding: Separate acute state effects from durable traits. A meditation or altered-state session may change q_state without establishing a lasting q_trait change.
A composite score can be used only as a predictive/psychometric index for a declared operational target such as attentional stability, compassion behavior or sustained nondual-report reliability.
research_findings.promotion_rule: Weights must be trained on one sample and evaluated on held-out data; compare against simpler baselines; do not rename E_star 'enlightenment' without a validated construct definition.

research_findings.finding: The recovered geometric Consciousness Spiral should not be linked to neural state sequences merely because both involve recurrence. A scientific bridge requires a measurable mapping from neural observables to polar coordinates and evidence that logarithmic-spiral geometry predicts held-out trajectories better than alternatives.

researcher_notes: The best scientific upgrade is to turn the Human Map from a collection of special numbers into a longitudinal state-space program.
Recent neuroscience reviews emphasize that metastability is useful but frequently used too loosely; the project should therefore define the estimator every time it uses the term.
HMM transition statistics create a natural bridge to the project's Door language while keeping the model empirical and falsifiable.

falsification_and_quality_rules: Predefine the operational target before feature selection.
Use motion/artifact controls and appropriate multiple-comparison correction.
Compare dynamic models to static connectivity and simple autoregressive baselines.
Report uncertainty, reliability and out-of-sample performance.
Do not infer supernatural causation from neural correlation.
